items.title: Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients Teasers
items.summary: In this post we will compile all the Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients teasers as they're posted.

zh.title: 流放之路 2：先人回归预告汇总
zh.summary: GGG 会在这篇帖子中持续汇总《流放之路 2：先人回归》的预告内容。

items.title: Fate of the Vaal as Core Path of Exile 2 Mechanic
items.summary: As you may know, Atziri’s Temple is staying in Path of Exile 2 as a core mechanic when Return of the Ancients launches on May 29th. Find out the details in this news post.

zh.title: 瓦尔命运将成为流放之路 2 核心机制
zh.summary: 阿兹里的神殿会在 5 月 29 日先人回归上线后保留为核心机制，公告说明了具体改动。

items.title: Reworked Uniques - Reverie and Hollow Mask
items.summary: In Return of the Ancients, embrace your botanist side and equip the Hollow Mask which gives you a direct connection to the Goddess Viridi, or give yourself to the woods to gain the Rite of Restoration with the Reverie mantle.

zh.title: 重做传奇：Reverie 与 Hollow Mask
zh.summary: 先人回归中，Reverie 与 Hollow Mask 两件传奇会被重做，围绕 Viridi 与恢复仪式提供新玩法。
